Indo-MIM Shares Surge on Strong Q1 Profit Growth

Indo-MIM's shares on the BSE reached the 10% upper circuit, trading at Rs 951.30 on Tuesday. This surge followed the precision components manufacturer's announcement of a 31.6% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending June 30, 2026. The company reported a net profit of Rs 240 crore for the period.
